title: Structured Logging
description: Design structured logging with correlation IDs.

data.text: Structured logging emits logs as structured data (JSON) rather than plain text. This makes logs searchable and analyzable.

terms.definition: Logging structured data (JSON) instead of plain text.
Additional data attached to logs (user, request, correlation ID).
An ID that traces a request across services.

items: timestamp: when the log was created

data.text: Centralize logs in a system like Elasticsearch, Splunk, or Datadog. This enables searching and analyzing logs across all services.
